figures.caption: Figure 1. Fire rate (fraction of teacher utterances where that assertion is true) versus cross-model agreement for each assertion. Fire rate is averaged across the five annotators. Construct-derived (top-down) assertions are colored in blue while Corpus-derived (bottom-up) assertions are colored in red.
Figure 2. Average Macro-F1 of the TalkMoves classifiers with a growing set of assertions. Black line is an average across all runs and annotators.
